scheme_name: Shreshtam Scheme For Ensuring Participation Of PwDs In Arts & Sports
other_conditions: The applicant must have a disability of 40% or more.
The applicant must have showcased talent in arts or sporting activities at State or National level championships.
The applicant must be undergoing training at State or National Academies or Centers.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹10,000 per beneficiary, with 10 beneficiaries selected from each district of Kerala.
